cascades.question: Was the diuretic added for ankle swelling after the calcium channel blocker was started? Has this link been reviewed?
Did the gout treatment start after the thiazide diuretic? Has the diuretic been considered as a contributing cause?
cascades.note: According to Gurwitz 1997, the risk only rises significantly at thiazide doses of 25 mg/day or more (hydrochlorothiazide equivalents). The rule does not check the dose.

cascades.question: Was the potassium supplement added because of the loop diuretic? Is it still needed with the current treatment?
cascades.note: ThinkCascades (McCarthy 2022, p. 838) left diuretic -> hypokalemia -> potassium out of its final list because it is usually intentional and appropriate. Always present it as a hypothesis to review.

cascades.question: Did the cough start after the ACE inhibitor was started? Has the ACE inhibitor been considered as a possible cause?
Was the antiparkinsonian drug added for symptoms that appeared after the antipsychotic? Has this link been reviewed?
Did the incontinence start after the cholinesterase inhibitor? Was this link considered before adding the antispasmodic?
Was the antihypertensive started or increased during NSAID treatment? Has this link been reviewed?
Did the urinary symptoms start after the diuretic? Has this link been reviewed?
Did the dizziness start after the alpha-blocker was started? Was this link considered before the anti-vertigo drug?
Was the dementia medication started while taking the benzodiazepine? Has the benzodiazepine been considered as a possible cause?
Was the dementia medication started while taking the urinary anticholinergic? Has this link been reviewed?
Did the insomnia start after the antidepressant? Was this link considered before the sleep medication?
Was the antipsychotic added for agitation related to the benzodiazepine? Has this link been reviewed?
